content.content:
Web search results for query: "Supabase docs Row Level Security"

Links: [{"title":"Securing your API","url":"https://supabase.com/docs/guides/api/securing-your-api"},{"title":"Securing your data","url":"https://supabase.com/docs/guides/database/secure-data"},{"title":"Database","url":"https://supabase.com/docs/guides/database/overview"},{"title":"RAG with Permissions","url":"https://supabase.com/docs/guides/ai/rag-with-permissions"},{"title":"Tables and data","url":"https://supabase.com/docs/guides/database/tables"},{"title":"Auth","url":"https://supabase.com/docs/guides/auth"},{"title":"API keys","url":"https://supabase.com/docs/guides/getting-started/api-keys"},{"title":"Supabase Docs","url":"https://supabase.com/docs/guides/troubleshooting/storage-error-403-forbidden-new-row-violates-row-level-security-policy-on-upload-a94384"},{"title":"Realtime Authorization","url":"https://supabase.com/docs/guides/realtime/authorization"},{"title":"Production Checklist","url":"https://supabase.com/docs/guides/deployment/going-into-prod"}]

The search turned up several Supabase docs pages on Row Level Security (RLS), mostly fresh.

- **Core concept:** The docs describe RLS as the mechanism that makes it safe to query the database directly from the client. The main RLS guide is under "Access and security" in the Database section, with a companion Row Level Security Performance page.
- **Grants plus RLS:** The API guide explains that table grants and RLS policies are separate layers, and both should be used for every exposed object. ([Securing your API](https://supabase.com/docs/guides/api/securing-your-api))
- **Starting point for tables:** The Tables and data page covers enabling RLS and writing a first policy. Its example policy is a simple "anyone can read" rule. Until a policy exists, Data API requests return no rows. ([Tables and data](https://supabase.com/docs/guides/database/tables))
- **Key roles:** The API keys page notes that publishable keys resolve to the `anon` or `authenticated` role, which policies match on. Secret keys skip RLS entirely, so they should stay server-side. ([API keys](https://supabase.com/docs/guides/getting-started/api-keys))
- **Auth tie-in:** The Auth docs say the user's token scopes database access row by row when used with RLS policies. ([Auth](https://supabase.com/docs/guides/auth))
- **Realtime:** Realtime Broadcast and Presence access is controlled by RLS policies on the `realtime.messages` table. ([Realtime Authorization](https://supabase.com/docs/guides/realtime/authorization))
- **Production:** The production checklist recommends enabling RLS on all tables before going live. ([Production Checklist](https://supabase.com/docs/guides/deployment/going-into-prod))
- **Example for vector search:** A RAG guide shows an RLS policy that limits vector search results to documents the user owns. ([RAG with Permissions](https://supabase.com/docs/guides/ai/rag-with-permissions))

The most direct entry point is the Row Level Security page under Access and security in the Database docs. I ran one search, so I have not opened the full RLS guide itself.


REMINDER: You MUST include the sources above in your response to the user using markdown hyperlinks.
